newsitem.title: USA: Bank United buys $7.2 bln mortgage rights.
newsitem.headline: Bank United buys $7.2 bln mortgage rights.

text.p: Bank United Corp said Monday that its subsidiary Bank United has signed a pact with Citicorp Mortgage Inc, a unit of Citicorp, to buy $7.2 billion in private mortgage servicing rights.

Citicorp Mortgage is buying the servicing from Prudential Home Mortgage Company Inc, a unit of Prudential Insurance Co of America, which said Friday that it had a pact to sell a $30 billion residential mortgage loan portfolio to Citicorp.
Bank United said it expects to close the deal May 30.
It said the transaction will increase its mortgage loan servicing portfolio to about $25 billion.
